import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
nodes=d.get('nodes',{})
counts={}
for name,info in nodes.items():
    st=info.get('state','?')
    counts[st]=counts.get(st,0)+1
print('total processes:',len(nodes))
print('state counts:',counts)
print()
for name,info in sorted(nodes.items()):
    if info.get('state')!='RUNNING':
        print('NOT RUNNING:',name,info.get('state'),'last_exit:',info.get('last_exit_code'))
